name: Get Me Out of Here!
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.

narrative.details:
Get me out of here!

I came up to the Valley of Spears to talk to the Maraudines.  I thought I could do a little business with them... but they don't want to talk!  I think they want to eat me!

Get me out of here and my brother Hornizz will pay you big!  He's at our camp next to the kodo graveyard, to the east.

Let's hurry, adventurer.  Not two minutes ago I heard some centaurs talking about getting wood for their cookpot...
narrative.objectives: Escort Melizza Brimbuzzle, then speak with Hornizz Brimbuzzle at the Kodo Graveyard in Desolace.
narrative.offerRewardText: My sister Melizza said you'd be coming.  Thanks a lot for getting her out of the jam she was in; it's too bad that she's already probably found herself in a new one!
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you seen my sister Melizza? She's always on the go, which gets her into trouble all the time.
